_comment: Wolf archetype -- Lupa, the lone surviving legend of the pre-failure Wood (per [[selva-wood-lore-locked-2026-05-31]] and story.md Beat 2). Quaternius rig (CC0), quadruped using the 'wolf' skeleton (config/skeletons/wolf.json). Pattern B boss (already-there, sitting outside the chapel). 'Tired legend' framing locked: slow walking pursuit, single bite attack -- but legend-tier HP and devastating damage per landed bite. She LOOKS exhausted because she IS, but a wolf-of-old still hits like a god. Tune in-game by adjusting damage and HP override.
_idle_clip_note: Pre-engage: eating loops naturally -- she's actively chewing the Lonza carcass at her feet (per the Capitoline-inversion framing: she's outlived the founders by devouring them). Loop-eating reads stronger than a frozen sad pose; the player walks up to find the apex predator mid-meal. combat_idle_clip = idle_2 = post-engage idle while she pauses between bites at the player.
_locomotion_note: Walking only -- no gallop, no leap. Lupa moves SLIGHTLY faster than the player (~2.4 m/s vs player 1.6 m/s) so a pure backpedal cannot escape her. Inexorable creep, not pursuit. No chase_speed override would leave her at player walk_speed and the player could outwalk her -- she needs the small edge.
_strafe_note: No duel-circle dance. Quadruped pursuit is straight-line walk into bite range.
_flinch_note: Wolf rig has only 2 hit-react clips (idle_hit_react_left/right). Maps all 4 flinch directions + both hit_react tiers to these. Crude but better than silent no-op (humanoid defaults like 'flinch_front' don't exist in the wolf registry; unmapped fields skip the play-once entirely).
_boss_note: Pattern B boss: initial_state=eating holds AI ticks off until engage_trigger fires. idle_clip (eating) loops naturally as her pre-engage animation -- she's mid-meal on the Lonza carcass. On engage, NO engage_clip plays -- she simply transitions from eating to combat_idle (idle_2) via the sampler's natural blend. Reads as 'she lifts her head, looks at you, decides you're more food.' Slow walking pursuit follows. Avoids needing a 'rise-to-attention' clip we don't have authored (jump_to_idle includes a physical jump that breaks the tired-legend framing).
_stats_note: Legend HP, broken poise. 600 HP = ~30 player bites at average melee. Poise=40 means even light hits stagger her -- the player feels the trade landing instantly, every swing matters, but she keeps coming.
_scripted_death_note: Lupa was poisoned by the Guide (Lonza-carcass) before the Vagrant arrived. Per story.md Beat 3 + [[guide-pawn-doctrine-2026-06-01]]: she dies on a 30s timer regardless of player damage. The HP-floor in PerFrameTick gates the player at 1 HP while she is Engaged with a scripted_death_seconds > 0 -- the player cannot die to her. Player damage that finishes her EARLY also works (Engaged -> Felled via fireEnemyDeath at HP=0); the timer is a guaranteed-lethal backstop. 30s gives a real fight window without dragging.
_item_drops_note: Wood-side organic loot, NOT Hell-substance. Per locked Wood-lore + Animal-form cosmology: Lupa is the lone surviving Wood-legend; killing her yields the matter of her body, not sangue. Sangue is absent from this archetype (sangue_drop field omitted) by design -- forcing Lupa into the Hell-substance economy would be cosmologically wrong. Item ids are stable identifiers; the pickup + inventory layer is TBD (item registry not yet wired). fireEnemyDeath currently logs the drop list; future commit ties to inventory.
_actions_note: ONE action: a single deadly bite. No pounce, no gap-closer, no chain. Souls-style windup/active/recovery: 300ms windup (player's dodge window) + 180ms active (hitbox live) + the rest of the clip as recovery (locked body, can't slide). 35 damage per bite = a few bites kill the player. cooldown 1.4s -- she can land roughly one bite per 2 seconds.
_lockon_note: Multi-point lockon (ER convention for boss-scale enemies). default=head so first acquire snaps to Lupa's head -- the natural focal point. Mouse wheel cycles head -> torso -> hindleg_left -> hindleg_right -> wrap.
